evidence.claim: GE Vernova describes itself as delivering products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity, and positions Grid as part of modernized and digitized grid infrastructure.
evidence.source_title: Investor Relations | GE Vernova | The Energy of Change

evidence.claim: GE Vernova materials identify HVDC systems as enabling utilities to move more power over longer distances, integrate renewables, interconnect grids, and improve network performance; the same resource page points to FACTS/FLEX STATCOM.
GE Vernova’s FACTS press release says its Grid Solutions business had won five FACTS projects and describes a Hybrid STATCOM at an HVDC interconnection substation between Saudi Arabia and Egypt.
evidence.source_title: GE Vernova’s Industry-Leading Flexible AC Transmission System (FACTS) Portfolio Helps Customers Meet Complex Grid Challenges

evidence.claim: AMSC markets D-VAR STATCOM systems that dynamically adjust reactive power at key grid points and address interconnection and power-quality challenges.
AMSC states that D-VAR reactive compensation systems are STATCOMs and part of the FACTS family of power-electronic solutions for AC grids.
evidence.source_title: AMSC Announces $6 Million in STATCOM Orders in Asia Pacific

evidence.claim: AMSC reported third-quarter fiscal 2025 revenue of $74.5 million, up from $61.4 million year over year, and a 12-month backlog above $250 million, but the release does not isolate D-VAR contribution.
evidence.source_title: AMSC Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results and Business Outlook

evidence.claim: TCI, an Allient company, describes itself as a manufacturer of active and passive harmonic filters for harmonic mitigation and power quality, including line reactors and filters used for IEEE-519 compliance.
Allient’s power page references harmonic and motor-protection solutions and shows active harmonic filter products under its power offerings.
Allied Motion, now Allient, acquired TCI, described as a developer and manufacturer of active and passive products for power-quality and harmonic issues associated with industrial power conversion.
evidence.source_title: Allied Motion Acquires TCI | Industrial Distribution

evidence.claim: Preformed Line Products says it designs and manufactures products and systems used in construction and maintenance of overhead and underground networks for energy, telecommunications, cable, data communications, and similar industries.
PLPC’s 2024 Form 10-K reported 2024 net sales of $593.7 million, with energy and communications end markets relevant to grid and network construction.

External underfollowed research argues PLPC may be an obscure transmission-hardware beneficiary with low Wall Street coverage and utility-specification stickiness; this is a useful lead but requires primary-source verification.
evidence.source_title: The Only Pure-Play Transmission Hardware Stock Nobody Is Talking About

memory_update.text: AMSC should remain in the Layer 1B universe as a direct US-listed STATCOM / FACTS / power-quality candidate; next layer must separate D-VAR/Gridtec revenue from wind, naval, and acquisition-driven revenue.
ALNT is a hidden-mapping candidate through subsidiary TCI; the thesis depends on whether harmonic filters and reactors are material enough inside consolidated Allient results.

PLPC is an adjacent transmission-hardware candidate, not a direct FACTS/HVDC equipment supplier; keep it only if later evidence links products to high-voltage transmission buildout, reconductoring, or utility-approved grid hardware.
GEV is the reference benchmark for HVDC/FACTS/STATCOM system-level demand and can be used to triangulate smaller supplier bottlenecks, backlog, qualification cycles, and component shortages.

Need a separate non-US/global ADR or OTC pass for purer HVDC reactor, instrument-transformer, capacitor-bank, and harmonic-filter suppliers; many likely candidates are listed in India, Europe, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, or Canada rather than on major US exchanges.

node: HVDC, FACTS, high-voltage reactors, harmonic filters, STATCOM systems, instrument transformers, and grid power-quality equipment
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around HVDC/FACTS and power-quality chokepoints using a two-lane funnel. GE Vernova is the obvious reference anchor for HVDC/FACTS/STATCOM context. The underfollowed lane surfaces AMSC for direct STATCOM/reactive-power exposure, Allient through TCI harmonic filters and line reactors, and Preformed Line Products as an adjacent transmission-hardware beneficiary whose exposure is not pure FACTS/HVDC but may benefit from the same grid-upgrade cycle. No trading recommendation is implied.
